claim_family: high nickel cathodes and lithium hydroxide demand expectation
question: What did contemporaneous 2018-2020 sources expect about high-nickel cathode adoption and lithium-hydroxide demand, and how was that expectation revised when adoption progressed more slowly than expected?
why_replay_critical: This is the Expectation side of the conversion cycle. A later history can easily make high-nickel-to-hydroxide demand look inevitable; the replay must preserve both the original bullish thesis and the contemporaneous slowdown/counter-scenario.

required_time_semantics.known_time: filing/publication date of each expectation statement
required_time_semantics.valid_time: market conditions or adoption period the statement describes
required_time_semantics.expectation_horizon: future chemistry/lithium-demand period forecast by the source
required_time_semantics.revision_link: newer expectation must point back to the older expectation it revises without deleting either

required_outputs: archive Livent/FMC 2018 annual expectation, Livent 2019 Q1 slowdown revision and Livent 2019 annual expectation
archive the SQM 2019 scenario source and preserve its conservative/optimistic alternatives rather than selecting one ex post
archive the named BloombergNEF origin analysis if used to support an external forecast statement
extract the reason given at each vintage: high-nickel adoption, performance requirement, slower transition, carbonate substitution or market uncertainty
avoid numeric forecast claims unless the exact underlying dated table is archived
represent expectation disagreement/revision as first-class trajectory data
forbidden: rewrite 2018 optimism using knowledge of later LFP resurgence
call the hydroxide thesis an industry consensus merely because several later pages repeat it
treat BloombergNEF as primary evidence for Livent management belief or vice versa
interpret failure to locate a forecast table as contradiction
done_when: At least three dated expectation vintages and one explicit contemporaneous negative revision/counter-scenario are archived, with source clusters separated and no later outcome used to overwrite earlier belief states.
